data.text:
Zuber Ahmad @ Raju vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. (Food Safety) 
... on 19 March, 2024 
Author: Vivek Chaudhary
Bench: Vivek Chaudhary
High Court Of Judicature At Allahabad, Lucknow Bench
?Neutral Citation No. - 2024:Ahc-Lko:23896-Db
Court No. - 2
Case :- Writ - C No. - 2665 of 2024
Petitioner :- Zuber Ahmad @ Raju
Respondent :- State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. (Food Safety) Civil Secrt. Lko. And 2 Others 
Counsel for Petitioner :- Vijay Kumar Asthana,Rizwanul Haque Ansari,Santi Counsel for Respondent :- C.S.C.
Hon'ble Vivek Chaudhary,J.
Hon'ble Om Prakash Shukla,J.
Heard learned counsel for petitioner and learned standing counsel for State. 
Present writ petition is filed by the petitioner for the following primary relief:-
"a. issue a writ, order or direction the nature of mandamus, directing the opposite parties to renewal the cracker shop license of the petitioner, which was issued since 2004 and the same has renewed time to time.
Zuber Ahmad @ Raju vs State Of U.P. Thru. Secy. (Food Safety) ... on 19 March, 2024 Indian Kanoon - http://indiankanoon.org/doc/169691944/
1 b. issue a writ, order or direction in the nature of mandamus, directing the opposite party No.2 to decide the representation of the petitioner which has given to renewal the cracker shop license of the petitioner dated 01.03.2024."
Learned counsel for petitioner submits that grievance of petitioner would be sufficiently met in case representation of petitioner for the said purposes is considered and decided in a time bound manner.
Learned standing counsel has no objection to the same. 
In view thereof, petitioner is permitted to make a fresh detailed representation to respondent no.2 District Magistrate, District-Lakhimpur Kheri, raising all his grievance, annexing therewith all the documents in support of his claim within a period of two weeks from today along with a certified copy of this order. 
In case such a representation is moved by petitioner, respondent no.2 shall consider and decide the same in accordance with law by a reasoned and speaking order within a period of three months from the date a certified copy of this order along with representation is placed before him. 
It is made clear that this court has not applied itself on the merits of the case and all questions are left open to be considered and decided by the competent authority in accordance with law. 
With the aforesaid directions, the writ petition is disposed of. 
Order Date :- 19.3.2024 Arti/-
[Om Prakash Shukla,J.] [Vivek Chaudhary,J.]
